## What would you like to do?

Describe the user problem or use case this feature would solve.

## What should happen?

Describe your preferred behavior. If useful, add a small example or sketch.

## Safety and privacy considerations

Would the idea read or change files, use the microphone/camera, send data to an API, or control a browser/window? How should user consent work?
